plainText:
Lacey (Japanese: タロ Taro) is a character introduced in The Indigo Disk in . She is a second-year student attending Blueberry Academy, and a member of the Elite Four. She uses Pokémon.

==In the core series games==
===Appearance===
Lacey is a young woman with pale skin, pink hair, and hazel eyes. She has pink and green pins in her hair, near her ears. She wears a long lavender coat with sashes around the arms with decoration resembling fairy wings over the BB Autumn Uniform. She wears white sneakers.

=== History ===

==== Background ====
Lacey is a girl who likes cute Pokémon, which led to her becoming a Trainer of types. Her father is Driftveil City Gym Leader Clay, with whom she shares the same . When interacting with Nemona in the League Club Room, she and Lacey are revealed to know each other, with Nemona having battled her father in the middle of a fancy party.

==In the TCG==
 
 
Lacey is introduced as a in the Pokémon Trading Card Game during the English Scarlet & Violet Series (the Japanese Scarlet & Violet Era). It was first released in the Japanese expansion and the English expansion, with artwork by Sanosuke Sakuma. An version with artwork by the same illustrator and a version of the card illustrated by Souichirou Gunjima were released in the same sets. It allows the player to shuffle their hand into their deck and draw 4 cards, or 8 cards if their opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining.
 

==Trivia==
The French official website for misspelled Lacey's French name (Taro) as "Tara" in the subheading for her. This error was fixed as of September 11, 2023. 
Lacey is the only notable specialist to be an Elite Four member.
Lacey is the only member of the BB Elite Four whose designated Terastallized Pokémon is not of her specialty type prior to being Terastallized. It is also the only such Pokémon to be first discovered in Unova.
Lacey is also the only member of the BB Elite Four to use more than one Pokémon not of her specialty type.
Lacey is the only member of the BB Elite Four to use the final evolution of a First Partner Pokémon found in the same biome they fight the player in. Lacey is fought in the Coastal Biome and uses a Primarina and Popplio spawn in the Coastal Biome after boosting biodiversity.
While Lacey refers to her usage of and in her first battle as her "Plus-Minus strategy", they each have their Hidden Abilities and rather than and , respectively, and her strategy relies on using to trigger them.
Lacey's Rotom Phone uses a Fairy Case.
